title: Distilling the knowledge with quantum neural networks
summary: Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) are a promising class of quantum machine learning models with potential quantum advantages when implemented on scalable, error-corrected quantum computers. However, as system sizes increase, deploying QNNs becomes challenging. Similar to their classical counterparts, a key obstacle to their practical applications is that large-scale QNNs may not be easily deployed on smaller systems that have limited resources.
